source: Authored from kuairand-starter-kit/README.md '从哪里开始改' (tested dead-ends + ranked unexplored directions) and the challenge problem statement.

loss.description: Training objective. Baseline is pointwise logloss but the metrics (GAUC/nDCG@5) are within-user ranking metrics — organizers rank aligning the loss with the metric as the single most promising unexplored direction.

pointwise_logloss.description: Baseline: per-impression binary cross-entropy on long_view.

bpr_pairwise.description: BPR: sample (positive, negative) impression pairs within the same user, maximize P(s_pos > s_neg).

listwise_softmax.description: Per-user softmax over that user's train impressions, cross-entropy toward the positives (ListNet-style).

listwise_softmax_plus_pointwise.description: Weighted hybrid: listwise softmax + pointwise logloss. Keeps calibrated head while aligning with ranking.

score_prior.description: Leakage-safe empirical-Bayes ranking prior learned only from the training window, then blended with the model logit. Item and author long-view rates provide a low-variance memorization path that complements interaction models; smoothing protects rare entities and the recency variant targets temporal drift.

none.description: No post-training prior blend; use the model score directly.

bayesian_item_author.description: Blend the model logit with smoothed train-only item and author long-view logits. Uses global-prior shrinkage for rare and unseen entities. Same-seed baseline check: +0.0002 primary (weak control).

recency_bayesian_item_author.description: As above, but exponentially downweight older training interactions so the prior follows recent preference and catalog trends. Same-seed baseline check: +0.0009 primary; prefer this variant.

user_history.description: Behavior-sequence features. Baseline uses zero history; each user has hundreds of train interactions. Second-ranked unexplored direction (DIN/SIM family). NOTE: purely user-side features only work through interaction with item-side features — first-order user terms are constant within a user and cannot change within-user ranking.

mean_pool_positives.description: Mean-pool embeddings of the user's past positive (long_view) items from the train period as an extra field that interacts with the candidate item.

recency_weighted_pool.description: Like mean_pool_positives but exponentially decayed toward recent interactions.

din_attention.description: DIN-style attention: weight history items by similarity to the candidate item before pooling. Needs an MLP-based model to consume the pooled vector.

multitask.description: Multi-feedback auxiliary tasks. Log has is_click, is_like, is_follow, is_comment, is_forward, play_time_ms on EVERY impression (no sample-selection bias for long_view). Third-ranked direction.

aux_click.description: Shared embeddings, auxiliary head on is_click, weighted joint loss.

aux_click_like_forward.description: Auxiliary heads on is_click, is_like, is_forward.

censored_watch_time.description: CWM-inspired: auxiliary censored-regression head on play_time (a completed play truncates true watch time, so use a one-sided loss). Fourth-ranked direction.

model.description: Scoring model. Tested dead-end: raising FM capacity (k=8/16/32) does NOT help, so model swaps rank below loss/history/multitask. Torch 2.3 (CPU) is available.

deepfm_mlp.description: DeepFM: FM interaction + MLP over concatenated field embeddings (torch, CPU).

temporal.description: Time features and train→eval distribution shift (hourmin, date). Sixth-ranked direction. Remember: a time feature only matters through interaction with item-side features.

hour_bucket.description: Hour-of-day bucket from hourmin as an extra categorical field.

hour_plus_dow.description: Hour bucket plus day-of-week from date.

training.description: Optimization schedule. Tested dead-end: capacity k=8/16/32 barely moves the score — prefer schedule changes that serve the loss axis over raw capacity.

default.description: Baseline: k=16, lr=1e-3, batch 8192, max 40 epochs, patience 4.

k32.description: k=32 (tested ~neutral; only useful combined with new signal sources).

two_stage_finetune.description: Stage 1 pointwise warmup, stage 2 fine-tune with the selected ranking loss at lower lr.

data_extras.description: Extra data sources beyond the two standard logs. Leakage-sensitive: locked options are mechanically unselectable without a human-set override flag.

video_stats_features.description: video_features_statistic_pure.csv aggregate counters (show_cnt, play_cnt, ...). LOCKED: statistics are aggregated over a window that overlaps the validation/test dates — using them as features risks target leakage from the evaluation period.

random_log_test_period.description: Rows of log_random_4_22_to_5_08_pure.csv with date in the test window (20220429–20220508). LOCKED: direct test-period exposure.

random_log_valid_unbiased_check.description: Rows of the random-exposure log restricted to the VALIDATION window (20220422–20220428), used as an extra unbiased evaluation diagnostic only — never as training data. Allowed (organizers suggest it).

tested_dead_ends: Adding static features (all 13 CWM fields + user-side coarse buckets): primary 0.5940 vs 0.5950 — no gain.
Raising FM embedding dim k=8/16/32: 0.5895/0.5902/0.5887 — no gain.
Pure user-side first-order terms contribute exactly 0 to within-user ranking.
notes.hidden_test_discipline: Generated solutions may WRITE test-split scores to disk (scores_test.npy) but must never read test labels or compute test metrics; only the harness scores test once at the very end.
